decisions.reason: The cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's floor-care knowledge, and its own page in 2024 shows that management reads its early results as positive and is promoting it.
The maintenance oil line rests on the firm's surface-treatment expertise and complements its oiled floors, so the firm can interpret its performance and refine it in-house.
The care line for oiled floors closely matches existing know-how, and its upgrade to its own page in 2024 signals continued investment.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to the flooring systems the firm already understands technically, and it stayed steadily listed, supporting system sales.
The high-density foam underlay relies somewhat more on non-wood materials know-how, but as a matching accessory listed in both years it remains worth keeping.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's long wood-processing expertise and R&D, making it the strongest fit for further development.
